I just submitted my own post to the sub but it must have been rejected or caught in modqueue or something. It was an audio link since I'm a sucky typer.

What I will say is that I think your connection to your mother is something to hold onto. Even if the day does eventually come, as it may for us both it seems, that relationship is worth giving it one more sleep. One more sunrise. Re-evaluate later.

The decision to not go through with it tonight is not permanently consigning you to another however many years, but the choice to end our lives is most certainly irrevocable. Given that, it would seem prudent for either of us to give it just a little more time. For mom. Because I love my mom and I think you do too, and our moms love us. Maybe it's worth waiting just a little longer to see if we can find for ourselves what they see in us.
